description: A stereo bubbling-water texture, between filtered noise and running water, with a width control over the result

params.text: Sets how quickly the bubbling moves, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how bright and lit the bubbling sounds, muffled at the far left and open at the far right, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets the rate of the modulation in the filter path, 0 to 100 per cent; the higher it goes the more chatter there is
Sets the stereo width, collapsing to mono at the far left, leaving the natural image at the centre and exaggerating the sides at the far right

inputs.text: Adds to the density knob, one volt moving it by ten percentage points
Adds to the clarity knob, one volt moving it by ten percentage points
Adds to the freq knob, one volt moving it by ten percentage points
Adds to the width knob, one volt moving the width by a fifth of a unit

notes: the module makes its own sound and takes no audio in; it sounds as soon as it is placed
the source is one mono signal offset by a very short delay between the two channels, which is what gives the width control something to work on
the module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu in this build

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
